snippet.title: Restitched: Level Editor Gameplay (2D Platformer Timelapse)
snippet.description:
In this time-lapse showcase, we're building a short segment for a 2D platformer level! Although Stuffy can move in full 3D, creators have the option to lock movement into a 2D style. We're using it here in combination with full camera settings, double jump, and more.

Restitched offers an intuitive level editor, all from the comfort of your mouse and keyboard, making it quick and easy to plop down assets or place Stuffy for instant playtesting...

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361090/Restitched/

Learn more: https://linktr.ee/trixelcreative
